endpoint.text: Composite of clinical response and microbiological eradication at the test-of-cure (TOC) visit (7 ± 2 days after end of treatment) in the micro-ITT population

citations.quote: The primary efficacy variable in this study was a composite variable requiring both Clinical Response and Microbiological Eradication at the TOC visit:

The trial evaluated the primary composite endpoint of clinical response and microbiological eradication at the test of cure visit (TOC, 7\pm 2 days from end of treatment) in the micro-ITT population using an NI margin of 15%.

n.text: 452 subjects randomized; micro-ITT population had 252 in the cefiderocol group and 119 in the IMP group (analysis excluding 11 GCP-noncompliant subjects)

citations.quote: A total of 452 subjects were randomized, which closely matched the planned sample size of 450 subjects.
response rates for the primary endpoint were 183/252 (72.6%) for the cefiderocol group and 65/119 (54.6%) in the IMP group

All efficacy analyses in the application and in this review exclude 11 subjects (10 in the cefiderocol group and 1 in the IMP group) from 2 study sites that the Applicant determined to be Good Clinical Practice noncompliant.

result.text: Composite success 183/252 (72.6%) with cefiderocol vs 65/119 (54.6%) with IMP; treatment difference 18.6% (95% CI 8.2% to 28.9%), meeting criteria for statistical superiority

citations.quote: response rates for the primary endpoint were 183/252 (72.6%) for the cefiderocol group and 65/119 (54.6%) in the IMP group, leading to a point estimate for the difference in success rates of 18.6%, and a 95% confidence interval for the difference from 8.2% to 28.9%.
cefiderocol met statistical criteria for declaring superiority to IMP, even though this study was designed as a noninferiority trial.

target_moa.text: Cefiderocol is a cephalosporin whose catechol moiety acts as a siderophore, chelating iron and using the bacterial iron transport system to penetrate the outer membrane; it then binds penicillin-binding proteins and inhibits cell wall (peptidoglycan) synthesis, producing bactericidal activity against Gram-negative bacteria

citations.quote: The catechol moiety of cefiderocol acts as a siderophore and forms a complex with iron and utilizes the bacterial iron transport system to penetrate the outer membrane of susceptible Gram-negative bacteria.
the antibacterial activity of cefiderocol is due to binding to penicillin-binding proteins (PBPs) and inhibition of peptidoglycan synthesis
Cefiderocol is a cephalosporin with bactericidal activity against Gram-negative aerobic bacteria.

key_safety.text: Most frequent adverse reactions (≥2%) were diarrhea (4%), infusion site reactions (4%), constipation (3%), rash (3%), candidiasis (2%), cough (2%), elevations in liver tests (2%), headache (2%), hypokalemia (2%), nausea (2%), and vomiting (2%). Serious adverse reactions occurred in 14/300 (4.7%) FETROJA patients; the most serious labeled risk is an increase in all-cause mortality in patients with carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections
